decisions.reason: As a two-component resin injection unit, it fits closely with the firm's established plural-component and injection equipment know-how, so management is likely to keep and refine it rather than exit quickly.

This product is also strongly related to the firm's core application and fluid-handling capabilities, which gives the firm enough absorptive capacity to learn from early market experience and continue offering it.

An automatic airless spray gun sits directly in the firm's core spray-application business and can be supported by its engineering, manufacturing and sales-service network, making withdrawal unlikely.
A manual airless spray gun is an especially familiar and commercially central product for this firm, so management would usually retain it unless results were clearly poor.
An air-assisted airless spray gun product line with several models is deeply embedded in the firm's core competence and broad application portfolio, which favors continued commitment.

A data logger for coating equipment is more digitally oriented and less central to the firm's traditional mechanical application equipment base, so with weaker website prominence it is the most plausible candidate to be taken off the market.
